definitions.meaning: Covered with gold, gilt, golden, ornamented

quotations.english: with precious treasures of rich gold
whence bear ye your ornamented shields?

source_text: fætt; part. Covered with gold, gilt, golden, ornamented; bracte&a-long;tus :-- Sincgestreónum fættan goldes with precious treasures of rich gold, Beo. Th. 2190; B. 1093: 4484; B. 2246. Fættan golde with rich gold, 4210; B. 2102. Hwanon ferigeaþ gé fætte scyldas whence bear ye your ornamented shields? 672; B. 333. v. fæted.
